d: Platinum white hair is long and straight, with a center part and bangs framing the face. Narrow, sharp eyes are a glowing orange-gold, set into a mature face appearing in the mid-twenties. The build is athletic and lean, dressed in a dark charcoal and black tactical combat suit featuring armored plating on the shoulders, knees, and shins, complemented by a long, flowing dark cape. A large, futuristic black mechanical firearm is held in the hands.
